features.name: MACD
features.formula_method: MACD = EMA(fast) - EMA(slow), Signal = EMA(MACD, signal_period)

features.name: ATR
features.formula_method: Average True Range: rolling mean of True Range

features.name: OBV
known_limitations: Does not account for price magnitude

features.name: Ichimoku Cloud
features.formula_method: Tenkan, Kijun, Senkou A/B, Chikou spans

features.name: GARCH Volatility
features.formula_method: EWMA of squared log returns as GARCH(1,1) approximation

features.name: HMM Regime
features.formula_method: Hidden Markov Model with 4 states on returns + volatility

features.name: Volume Profile
features.formula_method: Rolling volume statistics: SMA, ratio, z-score

features.formula_method: GPT-4o-mini news analysis producing sentiment [-1,1] and confidence [0,1]
